acceptance: CONTRIBUTING.md and RELEASING.md state the rule above, with the owner retaining stand-ins, adjudications, owner instructions and backoff resets.
No other file changes; merged with hosted SHIP + green required checks; merge SHA recorded here.
context: Part of theseus-review-output-format-20261110 (raised by the item-set review).
description:
CONTRIBUTING.md:5,7 requires the owner's full-diff review for every merge (and explicitly for release tooling and lock changes), and RELEASING.md:13 requires the owner to have reviewed every diff since the previous tag. On 2026-11-10 the owner chose the rule already used in practice since the self-gate went live: every PR needs a current-head review-verdict SHIP from theseus-review[bot] plus green required checks; changes to gate, receipt, dedup or posting code, workflows, policy or the lock additionally need an independent review (a fresh-context agent session that did not author the change, of the exact final head SHA, with reviewer, head and verdict recorded); before tagging, the releaser confirms every diff since the previous tag merged under this rule. Update both documents to say exactly that, and nothing else.
Guardrails: docs-only; does not change workflows, policy or the lock; hosted SHIP + green checks.
